title: What If Humans Disappeared Tomorrow?
lines: What if every human on Earth disappeared tomorrow?
At first, the lights would stay on, | for no one.
Within hours, with no one to run them, | power plants would shut down.
One by one, | the lights would go out.
Beneath New York, pumps keep the subway dry.
Without them, | the tunnels would flood in about two days.
In about twenty years, | cracked streets would turn to forest.
Within a few centuries, | steel bridges and towers would rust and fall.
Plastic could outlast them, | perhaps for a thousand years or more.
Some bronze statues might keep their shape for millions of years.
But our most lasting trace has already left the planet.
For about a century, | our radio and TV signals have raced outward at light speed.
Today they reach about a hundred light-years in every direction, | and they're still spreading.
